ops.title: Local capt-hook outage 2026-07-25: unattended 12.20.9 upgrade left trust registration incomplete
ops.body:
The 04:22 captain-hook upgrade to 12.20.9 (concurrent session) deployed `~/Applications/Captain Hook.app` and started the new daemon, but left the signed-deployment trust registration incomplete: every client probe got `wire: untrusted peer`, surfacing in other sessions as `captain: signed host is not installed and ready; run capt-hook helper install: wire: handshake failed` on PostToolUse hooks.

Repair (2026-07-25 ~12:30Z): `~/.claude/plugins/cache/captain-hook/captain-hook/12.20.9/bin/capt-hook helper install` → `helper v12.20.9 ok=True`.

Residual, expected noise: long-running Claude sessions have their plugin version baked at start — a session on the 12.19.1 plugin still errors with `fork/exec /Applications/Captain Hook.app/Contents/Helpers/capt-hookd: no such file` (12.19.1 expected the app in /Applications; ≥12.20 uses ~/Applications). Non-blocking; clears on session restart / plugin update. Also: the `capt-hook` CLI is plugin-shipped (brew ships only `capt-hook-host`), so it is not on interactive shell PATH — invoke via the plugin cache path.

Class note for the incident record: same upgrade-skew family as the fleet breakage — an unattended upgrade that restarts a daemon without completing its trust/convergence step strands every not-yet-restarted client.
